Provincial Councils Notifications
WESTERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Notification

IT is hereby announced under provisions of Section 289 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance read with Section 2 ofProvincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989 that the regulations on payment of Travelling Expensesto Mayors, Deputy Mayors and Councilors of Municipal Councils, formulated by me under powers vested by Section 289 ofMunicipal Councils Ordinance read with Section 2 of Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989 asthe Chief Minister and Minister in charge of the subject of Local Government of Western Province, and published in theExtraordinary Gazette paper No. 1846/19 dated 21st January 2014 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka wereadopted by the Western Provincial Council at the Council meeting held on 07.10.2014.
PRASANNA RANATUNGA,Chief Minister and the Minister of Finance and Planning, Law and Order,
Land, Education, Local Government and Provincial Administration,Manpower and Employment, Engineering Services and Information
of the Western Province Provincial Council
Chief Ministry of the Western Provincial Council,Shrawasthi Mandiraya,Colombo 07.03rd November 2014.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
